Since \(C=(1,0)\) is the circle’s center, we have \(A=(-1,0)\), so \(AC=2\). The height from \(B\) to \(AC\) is
\[
\left|y_B\right|=\left|\frac{4m}{m^2+1}\right|.
\]
Thus
\[
[\triangle ABC]=\frac12\cdot 2\cdot \left|\frac{4m}{m^2+1}\right|
=\left|\frac{4m}{m^2+1}\right|.
\]
Set this equal to \(\frac85\):
\[
\left|\frac{4m}{m^2+1}\right|=\frac85
\]
\[
5|m|=2(m^2+1).
\]
For \(m>0\):
\[
2m^2-5m+2=0 \implies (2m-1)(m-2)=0,
\]
so \(m=2\) is one value.

\[
\boxed{2}
\]
